name: ProjectMind for DeepSeek Harness (dsh / DeepSeek AI)
description: Universal project memory, profile MCP server, profile plugin overlay, and DEEPSEEK.md instructions for DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities.restartInstructions: Restart dsh session or reload profile with `dsh --dump-config` to confirm plugin/MCP server status.
documentedLimitations: DeepSeek Harness uses profile overlays; local .dsh/mcp.json and .deepseek/mcp.json are loaded into active profile stdio clients.

installationInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin install deepseek-harness` in your project root.
upgradeInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin update deepseek-harness` to refresh configs, skills, and hooks.
removalInstructions: Run `projectmind plugin uninstall deepseek-harness` to cleanly remove integration while preserving project knowledge.
